units.complete_old_prayer: Deus incommutabilis virtus, et lumen aeternum: respice propitius ad totius Ecclesiae tuae mirabile sacramentum, et opus salutis humanae, perpetuae dispositionis effectu tranquillius operare: totusque mundus experiatur et videat, dejecta erigi, inveterata renovari, et per ipsum redire omnia in integrum, a quo sumpsere principium: Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum Filium tuum: Qui tecum vivit.
units.complete_new_study_english: God, unchanging power and eternal light, look graciously upon the mystery of the whole Church, and carry out the work of human salvation in greater peace through the effect of your unending design. May the whole world experience and see the fallen raised up, the old made new, and all things restored to wholeness through Christ himself, from whom they took their beginning. Who lives and reigns for ever and ever. R. Amen.

units.complete_old_prayer: Adesto, Domine, supplicationibus nostris, ut sicut humani generis Salvatorem consedere tecum in tua maiestate confidimus, ita usque ad consummationem saeculi manere nobiscum, quemadmodum est pollicitus, sentiamus. Per.
units.complete_new_study_english: Lord, attend graciously to our supplications, so that, as we believe the Savior of the human race to be with you in your majesty, we may experience his remaining with us until the end of the age, as he himself promised. Who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, for ever and ever. R. Amen.

units.complete_expression_basis: The entire old Ascension prayer already joins supplications, belief that the Savior shares the divine majesty, his abiding with us to the consummation of the age, and his own promise, in this sequence. The modern changes reorder the invocation, add a conventional graciousness qualifier and explicit pronouns, replace confidence with belief and a synonymous promise construction, and remove the seated predicate. The whole finite revised expression requires review; retaining common themes alone is not a sufficient basis. Old Ascension and modern Easter7 appointments are distinct.
exact_changes: Transpose Adesto, Domine, supplicationibus nostris to Supplicationibus nostris, Domine, adesto propitius, adding propitius, a predicate adjective used adverbially.
Remove consedere, changing the explicit seated-with-you description to the retained with-you-in-your-majesty description. This predicate omission is substantive and explicitly disclosed.
Replace confidimus with credimus and move the verb between tua and maiestate.
Insert eum immediately after ita as the explicit subject of manere.
Replace quemadmodum est pollicitus with sicut ipse promisit: change the conjunction and synonymous promise verb while making the same subject explicit.

Replace the old Per. cue with the modern Qui tecum. long conclusion; its full words and separate Amen are independently old in Pustet1862AP88, and the exact secondary2002IGMR54 spells out the required modern form. No automatic truncation/expansion or exactoldwholebody identity is asserted.
units.strongest_contrary_argument: This prayer has several coordinated lexical, syntactic and predicate changes, not merely spelling or one-word correction. The removal of seated, invocation intensifier and explicit pronouns may constitute an editorial arrangement even though each clause has an old antecedent. A decision based solely on70percent coverage or common theological ideas would be invalid. The proposed finite assessment concerns this complete old two-clause supplication whose only actual narrative predicate change is removal of seated, with the same Savior, majesty, abiding, promise and time bound otherwise preserved. No general formula assembly or modern-prayer revision exemption is requested.
units.translation_fidelity_notes: Adesto propitius is attend graciously; humani generis is human race; credimus is believe, without reintroducing the removed seated predicate. Sentiamus is experiential and rendered experience his remaining, preserving both the abiding and end-of-age limit. Ipse and the promise remain explicit. Full God/Spirit/eternal conclusion and distinct response are retained.
